title: Schema Nebula
summary: A governed one-star-per-collection map of the 64 explicit MongoDB collection targets across the Saha Textile platform.

inventory.countPolicy: One node represents one distinct target MongoDB collection. Visual clusters never collapse several physical collections into one node.
inventory.statusPolicy: A star becomes solid only when a current adapter model resolves to that exact locked physical collection name. D1's grouped auth models currently resolve to lowercase Mongoose defaults rather than the graph's camelCase names, so they remain catalogue evidence without promoting target stars; authRateLimits is explicitly outside the locked 64-node graph.
